Name: Advanced_Copper_Tools
Author: Jared
Description: Adds copper-and-bronze metalworking content built from the metal sheets, nails and tin solder that CSFFModFramework 2.28.0 or later ships (one sheet card and one nail card in every metal, iron included), a small copper stove and a copper brazier that warm, dry and light the camp like any fire (a recruited Partner NPC can be given the vanilla Fire keeping duty on them and on the metal lantern; a Partner actually refuelling one is not yet confirmed in-game), wearable metal pan (multi-metal, weightless when worn) that can also pan river gravel for tin ore, large copper and iron saws with bonus tree-cutting, wheelbarrow with weight reduction, copper bathtub (3 states, with a Hot Bath tier for keeping the fire stoked, and a Wash with Soap interaction on the warm tub: a quick wash at any heat, so the fire need not be stoked), 4-variant metal lantern, which with the brazier and the copper oil flask takes any lamp oil in a clay bowl (ACT's rendered oil from animal fat or fatty fish meat, or with H&F installed rendered hemp seed oil and its own oils), copper oil flask, copper tea kettle, copper cauldron for batch cooking and brewing, sealed copper chest, a high-capacity open-topped Ore Bin for mined ore (greenstone, bog iron, tin ore, flint), a 3-variant Tea Blending Station with six herb slots, passive drying, a Grind All action, a built-in heated water reservoir, and three brewable herbal teas (Calming, Warming, Focus). Includes six metal armor suits (copper, tin, ghost bronze, tin bronze, white bronze and iron), each with a helmet, bracers, greaves and torso armor made from sheets of its own metal (ghost bronze wards against spiritual attacks and eases fear, white bronze bolsters courage), plus hand-held copper, iron and Ghost Bronze shields, all furnace-recyclable into their own metal. The oil flask, cauldron, large saw and small stove track the metal they were built from (copper through white bronze), sheets and nails every metal from copper to iron, and the saw and stove work differently by metal. Also adds a copper watering can, a copper-rim chamberpot, and Salt-Cured Meat and Salt-Cured Fish, slow-spoiling rations made from raw meat or lean fish and salt, and a Bedwarming Pan (fill it with embers at a fire and tuck it into your bed to sleep warmer). A Copper-Buckled Tool Belt on its own waist slot carries six hand tools (hammers, knives, chisels, sickles, spoon augers, fire strikers, the whetstone and needles); a Cautery Iron heated in a fire closes an open cut at the cost of a burn; a Copper Spigot fitted to a sap or resin tap makes it run about three times as long, and a Copper Sap Bucket hung in the tap catches its sap or gathers its resin; a carried Grappling Hook makes every climb more likely to succeed; and, with Sirus23 Mod Collection installed, Copper Shears shear its tame sheep before you have iron. Adds a branching cave system east of Waterfall Caves: the Metal Mines (tin) as its hub, with the Copper Vein Cave to its north and the Iron Vein Cave to its south, each with a minable ore vein, plus a Salt Mine east of the Copper Vein Cave and a Rock Quarry east of the Metal Mines, connected to each other north-south, each with its own minable vein and Collapsed Rock Face passage. The Copper and Iron caves each hold a mother lode that never runs out once you dig its seam clear (new caves only), and the mines are dark: mining needs a light, every exit always works without one, and the Metal Mines' daylight shaft lets you dig out by day.
